lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: The Ventures and the Tekiels already hate each other over the canal tolls. All they need is a shove. Get onto Keep Tekiel's roof, make it look like Venture men did it, and let the nobles do the rest of our work for us.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: That's a lot of guards for 'a shove.'

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Coinshots and hazekillers, both. Drop that gate on the courtyard below and every house in Luthadel will hear it by morning. That's the point.
